questionText:

1971?

options.text: It had a clear political and ideological programme.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: It was formed by all non-Congress parties.

options.text: It was formed by non-Communist and non-Congress parties.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Challenges to and Restoration of the Congress System.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Challenge to and Restoration of Congress System (Challenges to and Restoration of the Congress System):
It was formed by non-Communist and non-Congress parties.

It possessed no coherent common socio-economic agenda, relying entirely on the negative slogan 'Indira Hatao'.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Which of the following statement is correct about the transition of power
from Nehru to Shastri?
 
(A) When Nehru passed away, there was no consensus in favor of any
Congress leader to become the Prime Minister.
(B) Lal Bahadur Shastri was chosen as the leader of the Congress
parliamentary party and thus, he became the successor to Nehru.
(C) Nehru never depended on Lal Bahadur Shastri in his last year.
(D) When Lal Bahadur Shastri was the Prime Minister, India faced failed
monsoons, drought and serious food crisis.
 
Choose the correct answer from the following options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid scientific statements erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is false while Statement II is factually sound.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
When Nehru died in May 1964, Congress President K. Kamaraj forged a unanimous consensus in the party. Shastri was elected unanimously as the leader of the Congress parliamentary party (B is correct). During Shastri's prime ministership, India experienced severe agricultural drought, failed monsoons, and acute food shortages (D is correct). Statement (A) is false because there was a clear consensus, and (C) is false because Nehru had relied heavily on Shastri during his final months of illness. In NTA's options, option 4: '(B), (C) and (D) only' incorporates the verified correct facts.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

from Nehru to Shastri?
 
(A) When Nehru passed away, there was no consensus in favor of any

(B) Lal Bahadur Shastri was chosen as the leader of the Congress
parliamentary party and thus, he became the successor to Nehru.

monsoons, drought and serious food crisis.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

detailedSolution:

Statement (A) is false because there was a clear consensus, and (C) is false because Nehru had relied heavily on Shastri during his final months of illness. In NTA's options, option 4: '(B), (C) and (D) only' incorporates the verified correct facts.
Hence, option (B) is correct.

questionText:
Why did the Congress President S. Nijalingappa issue a whip on all the
Congress MPs and MLAs in 1969?

options.text: To vote in favour of abolition of privy purse
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: To vote in favour of anti-defection
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text:
To vote in favour of Sanjeeva Reddy, the official candidate of the
Congress party for Presidential elections.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Challenges to and Restoration of the Congress System.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Challenges to and Restoration of the Congress System (Challenge to and Restoration of Congress System):
In the August 1969 presidential election, Congress Syndicate leader and party President S. Nijalingappa issued a formal three-line whip instructing all Congress MPs and MLAs to vote strictly for the party's official candidate, N. Sanjeeva Reddy. Prime Minister Indira Gandhi defied this, advocating a 'conscience vote' that enabled independent candidate V.V. Giri to win.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
